selector.rationale: The presence of a reddish hematomalike plaque with a brownish peripheral border, along with immunohistochemical and histologic findings such as vascular channel endothelial cells positive for CD31, CD34, and D2-40, and prominent hemosiderin deposits, supports this diagnosis without contradiction.

rejected.label: Stewart-Treves syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of strong supporting evidence and low score

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Contradicted by low proliferation in endothelial cells and absence of cellular pleomorphism

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Negative HIV status and absence of HHV-8 positivity
